Deriving V from area_km2 x a thickness class -- as the brief suggests -- is circular, because the observed area then appears on both sides of the spreading law. Pass --volume-m3 from the official finding (e.g. Huntington: 588 barrels = 93.5 m3, NTSB MIR-24-01).
